integrity: Statements are supported by an analytic transform, subordinator coupling, Sturm-Liouville product and reproducible finite numerical checks. Finite checks are not a proof of infinite claims. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
limitations: Constant positive diffusivity and flat potential on one interval; one Robin reaction end and one irreversible escape end. No multi-target, heterogeneous medium or quantum-dynamical result. General spectral and local-time tools are prior work, and implicit older equivalent statements remain a literature-priority risk.
title: Conditional Robin capture has an independent spectral reaction delay
